Press Release:


Under the Prestigious Veneer
Once the pride of Gauteng’s education department, and with 100 years of prestigious heritage behind it, it’s still one of the most sought-after all-boys public schools in the province. But under this pristine veneer, there is a dark side to the story, a history of physical and sexual assault that has destroyed the lives of some of the young students. In this special report, the victims who spent years suffering in silence speak out, revealing the devastating details of how some teachers and fellow students, quietly carried out the abuse. Carte Blanche investigates.
Producer: Tarryn Crossman | Presenter: Derek Watts


Script:

























Time code Character/
Visual
1 00:00:00 V/O Parktown boys high school is one of the oldest public schools in Johannesburg constantly achieving excellence in both academics and sports. It is one of the Gauteng
department of education’s top 10 schools. Even though over the past 20 years Parktown boys has also become synonymous with allegations of brutal initiations and sexual assault.
2 00:00:24 Hayley This is a school that neglects children, that doesn’t take responsibility for its actions, where the entire structure is set up to look after one the traditions and two the code of silence
3 00:00:43 VO This year the tragic drowning of Enock Mpainzi at his G8 orientation camp was cited as another example of what this code of silence perpetuates. The boys from the camp were afraid to speak out, School management was told not to speak to the media and Enocks family were left desperate for answers
4 00:01:03 Yves The people who know the truth, the real truth about his death set up and just confess. Tell us the truth that’s all we need.
5 00:01:15 VO Enock went missing on Wednesday 15th of January during a water activity at the camp, because the school management did not notice he was missing the search and rescue only started almost 24 hours later. Enocks body was found in the river on the 17th of January. –
In March, after months of silence and speculation about who was accountable for Enock’s death, the provincial education department released a forensic report compiled by law firm Harris Nupen Molebatsi. It found the school and camp facility guilty of negligence.

6 00:01:53 Harris We find that the principle Mr Williams to be the subject of disaplinary action and largely the same with the educators
7 00:01:59 VO It wasn’t the first time this law firm investigated Parktown Boys. In 2018 they released a damning report into allegations of systemic abuse, going back as far as 2006. The information had been provided through an investigation undertaken by a group of Parktown Boys parents, led by my Michelle Hobkirk.

8 00:02:24 Michelle I am a taxpayer I have right a know what is going at that school its not the untouchhables and for every child name are going to call out that adult that didn’t think our children were precious enough
9 00:01:56 V/O These parents are Gathering together victim families and fighting for parktown boys to be held accountable for what they allege has been over 2 decades of systemic abuse. We interview families that have never spoken out before about the physical and sexual abuse they say their sons experienced while at the school.
10 00:02:13 Michelle Once we esculated this and went over the SGB’s head and got lawyers and started to intadict the school. I got sued by the SGB to stop talking
11 00:02:42 VO
The investigation starts in 2006 with the assault of Tish Skippers son Bradly. He committed suicide in 2019
12 00:03:12 Tish Skipper And they proceeded with what my son called PT hitting he told them please be careful because his back has skoliocis curviture of the spine and the response was oh good now we know where to hit you?

13 00:03:21 VO Tish Skippers son Bradly suffered from chronic Post traumatic stress disorder and depression because of the assault he suffered at Parktown boys in 2006.
His psychologists report was clear that this abuse played a role in his suicide

Multiple boys confirmed that Bradley was just one of many abused at these assemblies.
This man we call Charles to protect his identity, attended Parktown Boys 14 years ago and still remembers these Prefect’s Assembly.

14 00:04:13 Charles There would be a loud military siren that went off. You knew the teachers were involved as you would prefects saying mr or mrs so and so said you did do you homework or said that you were being rowdy in class. So the teachers basically used the matrics to do their dirty work
15 00:04:36 Vo The G12’s ruled the school through fear and what the parents discovered is that this fear is indoctrinated into the boys in their first week at the Parktown boys G8 camp. Hayley Shell’s son was another victim

16 00:04:53 Hayley Shell The school is quite obsessed with teaching the boys the parktown way.
How you learn the parktown way is you're taken to an orientation camp
Very military style. You are Screamed at.
You are deprived of sleep you are made to do knuckle ups on a gravel road we are talking about hours and hours of push ups over a 2 day period
One boy, His knuckles are now bruised and bleeding. He straightens his hand and a matric stands on it and breaks his fingers because that's against the rules

17 00:05:29 VO Luke Lambrecht from Woman And Men Against Child Abuse has worked with Parktown Boys for four years to attempt dismantling the toxic initiation culture and the code of silence that facilitates abuse…
18 00:05:44 Derek and Luke Derek: can you tell us what is the parktown way?

Luke: its almost lik they break you down to built you up so, its that hole idea that you go in as a group of individuals and you come out with a park town identiity. The overall culture it’s the park town way, its being part of something and that something is part of the old boys and that privlegde gives you access to certain kind of use of entry in business etc etc. so its almnost like you have to endure this in order to gain that.
19 00:06:16 V/O At the school the tradition of initiations and other rituals were used to reinforce this park town way
In 2009 Parktown made headlines for the brutal initiation of G11’s boarders by the G12’s.
The boys were taken onto the field at midnight forced to rub deep heat on their genitals and beaten with hockey sticks and cricket bats
Pene kimbers son was one of the boys abused

20 00:06:41 Pene Kimber Its almost as if its formt he medevil times, things like this shouldn’t happen.
21 00:06:46 VO When we told the story in 2009, the School Governing Body blamed the boys. Even though The head boy said they were performing an initiation ritual that had been done to them, and many before them.
23 00:07:00 Warren Haefele They need to suffer the consequence what they might be and that will be decided by the SGB not the school
24 00:07:06 VO But according to Lambrecht’s analyses of the situation, this was just another way that the school deflected blame from the teachers to the leaners
25 00:07:17 Luke I believe that the people that were supposed to incharge should be held accountable.

Derek: not just ignore and turn a blind eye?

Luke: well its illegal to ignore and turn a blind eye.
26 00:07:29 VO At the time we interviewed the then principle Tom Clarke who resigned from the school in 2010

27 00:07:36 Tom Clarke Perhaps she doesn’t fully realized to what extend she was over protecting him and not allowing him to develop to be manhood through his own personal development

The school has come to realize dealing with initiation as much deeper problems attached to it the school is dealing with it.
28 00:07:57 VO In 2009 the school released a statement saying the Management had now prohibited initiations. 9 years later, a boy filmed this video during a first team water polo tour. Again, the tradition of initiation seems to have continued

29 00:08:15 Boys video Every person here has gone through this.
You're not the first one.

Pupil: what happens on tour stays on tour

Camera guy: Louder!

Pupil: What happens on tour stays on tour

Initiate: Rule number 2

Pupil: if you cry you die!

Initiate: rule number 1

Pupil: what happens on tour stays on tour

Initiate: rule number two

Pupil: if you cry you die!

30 00:08:47 Recording I saw you cry…if you cry you die
31 00:08: 52 VO The Harris NM report of 2018 found this evidence enough to confirm that a teacher they called "D" knew about the initiations on sports tours and did nothing to stop them.

We asked the Department whether they held anyone responsible who’d been fingered in the report. They declined to comment at this time

Another Parktown code was “Snitches get stitches” this code is repeated by so many boys who have been assaulted at the school and suffered in silence like the boy in the initiation video who is Shells son

32 00:09:27 Hayley it all goes to a system of being a victim and a system of defending yourself because who knows no one else is going to look after you. Your parents aren’t because they don’t know and the matrics cant because they are the perpetrators. The SGB aren’t because they protect the school and not the child
33 00:09:47 VO After this video forced the school to take took action against the waterpolo team Hayleys son was victimised. It started with a boy spitting on his shoes

34 00:09:56 Hayley Spitting on the shoes in Parktown Boys is code for you're gonna get beaten up. Because snitches get stitches you may not talk He then runs into the bathroom, calls his father who calls me
He didn’t feel safe enough to walk from the bathroom to the front office where I would collect him from so he stayed on the phone with his father we removed him front he school

35 00:10:20 VO In 2017 Parktown faced its biggest scandal to date.
Collan Rex, a water polor coach and boarding master, was accused of sexually assaulting 23 school boys. He was seen on the boarding houses CCTV camera’s assaulting multiple pupils
We were given exclusive access to this footage used in the high court trail, but it was too damaging to the boys involved to be broadcast. Michelle was one of the first people to see the footage

36 00:10:50 Michelle He was assaulting them; he was violating their boundaries in the most in appropriate way. A 21-year-old adult young male fiddling with 12 and 13 year old. I mean the fact that Rex moved like he did in and out of those rooms and where were the masters? That was your job to look out after those kids in that time. We called the Hilbrow police we had him arrested and this journey started. To protect the boys
37 00:11:16 VO The parents believe it was the schools code of silence and fear that allowed Collan Rex to abuse these boys for almost 2 years in silence
38 00:11:26 Derek and Hayley Do you feel he has told you everything

Hayley: absoultly not, I know he hasn’t. you drop your child off, you pick them up, you sent to waterpolo game, rudgby game, or see teachers at feedback you do not have any idea what is happeing when those school gates close in te morning.
39 00:11:48 Link Derek Jason Dally is the only victim of Collan Rex that has ever spoken out publicly. In fact it was Jason who lead the hostel director to find the CCTV footage of Collan under the guise of looking for some missing waterpolo caps
40 00:12:02 Jason He started playing no rules water polo but his favourite thing was to get his hands on our pants and squeeze our genitals but I mean it’s a teacher so he says its no rules you do whatever you wanted, He would go around biting kids necks, sucking kids ears, playing with kids ears touching nipples. I think thats where it built up and built up and built up
Then it go to the point where Rex was knows for dry umping. He would come wrestle you while you're in bed and he would start touching you while he was wrestling you or start dry humping you while yore reading, lying in bed about to fall asleep you actually jump on you and start dry humping you and he would laugh. His laughter was his escape to absolutely everything

41 00:12:35 VO Collan Rex was a Parktown old boy who had attended the school from 2009 to 2013. His roommate’s affidavit detailed numerous complaints of his sexually inappropriate behavior toward younger boys. Rex’s behaviour didn’t change once he became a staff member.
42 00:12:53 Michelle There was a discussion with the masters this is according to this affidavit saying that Collan Rex is inappropriate.
43 00:12:58 VO This past pupil claims to have told the boarding masters at the time what Rex was doing. If this is true, then at least some members of school management were aware of Rex’s sexually inappropriate behaviour before they hired him in 2015. Jason also believes that multiple staff members knew what Rex was doing to them.
44 00:13:22 Jason I know Mr Hansen did know about it because in my opinion he was in the pool sometimes when we played no rule water polo. There were times I would say why are you squeezing my genitals and Mr Hansen I knew he would have herd things but I definitely knew he knew about stuff like that and I do believe
45 00:13:34 Hayley How were 23 boys groomed by a paedophile during school hours and hat school camps on the watch of masters in the school? Quit incredible
46 00:13:50 VO When the boys did finally give testimony in Rex’s trial they spoke about horrific sexual assault. REX would visit multiple rooms in the boarding house at night and do what he wanted with the boys. Some boys were assaulted in a bus with teachers and coaches sleeping in the front.
This is Brenda which is not her real name to protect her son, who was also a victim of Rex

47 00:14:16 Breanda It was only the social worker the last last social worker that he told and she said some of them she could not tell me. I remember saying to this lady I know you're not supposed to tell me what happened but this is my son. I cant help him if I don't know what's happening and she said definitely your son was sodomised by Collan Rex
48 00:14:37 VO Brenda found out that her son was a victim of Rex from Michelle, the school never informed her and to this day her son has never told her what happened. Discovering Rex’s assault on her son, shattered Hayleys world.
49 00:14:52 Hayley It’s a strange time actually because (cries) you kind of hoping for the best. But knowing the worst
50 00:15:10 Derek Link In 2018 Collan Rex was found guilty of 144 cases of sexual assault and 14 of common assault. He was sentenced to 23 years in jail. But no-one else from Parktown Boys High school has been held accountable
51 00:15:27 Luke I'm of the very strong belief that the hostel structure of the time of entry, his matriculating and him being brought back to the currently hostel parents need to be held accountable criminally in terms of section 54 of sexual offences act which mean if you know you must report
52 00:15:46 VO Rex was not the only predator at Parktown Boys. Susan's son was at the hostel in 2015. We protect her identity as her son, to this day, has not told her what happened to him.

53 00:16:00 Derek Link At the boarding house, there's a system where the new pods, which are 8, are given a grade 12 or old pod to mentor them through the first year. But according to some affidavit of the boys this isn’t always the case
54 00: 16:16 Susan They beat him, forced him to perform filation specifically dealing with erections in the morning
55 00:16:23 VO In susans son affidavit he wrote:
“The guy who was demanding blow jobs and hand jobs was my old pot. He was also assaulting us at night and on many occasions I did not actually do the blow job demanded but he forced me to fake it.”


56 00:16:39 Susan When my son came home, he actually insisted that I contact Mr Hansen to ask whether he could change his old pod. Mr Hansen agreed

Derek: did Dave Hansen investigate why your son wanted to change his old pod?

Susan: at the time he said to me he had dealt with the offenders, they would be punished and that I should leave it in his hands. I trusted the man Derek, I trusted him. My son was given a new old pod.

57 00:17:12 VO Whether or not Mr Hanson investigated the issue is unclear, but according to Susan it is clear that her sons old pot was simply given to another G8 and the abuse continued
58 00:17:24 Susan my son had to go through the guilt of listening to a child come into the dormitory at 12 at night and cry himself to sleep.


59 00:17:53 Link Derek We asked Dave Hansen for an interview but he declined, saying his current employers say he can't speak to us he denies all claims against him

60 00:17:43 VO The parents handed all their information to the school and education department. Neither has investigated Dave Hanson's alleged role in this.. He left Parktown Boys and is currently teaching at another state school in Gauteng.

61 00:17:55 Derek and Susan Derek: who do you blame for what happened to your son?
Susan: Derek I blame the enablers
62 00:18:03 Link We contacted PTB to find what they had done to rectify this situation and ensure that all their learners are safe. They denied us an on camera interview and instead furnished us with this statement

63 00:18:18 Statement Statement: From PTB
Reply from PTB
Parktown Boys' High School is in the process of healing from painful incidents in its past. Since 2018 they have a new school governing body, a new headmaster joined the school and over 50% of the teachers were changed in 2017 and 2018. Since the Collan Rex case they say that they have implemented the recommendations contained in the 2018 Harris Nupen Molebatsi Attorneys (HNM) report. The school also says they have employed the specialist advice of Rees Mann from the 'Male Survivors of Sexual Abuse' organisation and Lamprecht.
The school says they remain utterly committed to playing their part in ensuring Enock and the Mpianzi family receive the justice they deserve.


64 00:19:04 VO Post his suspension, as part of the process to investigate the death of Enock Mpianzi, Malcolm Williams has been reinstated as the principle of Parktown boys. His hearing however has been postponed due to COVID-19 but is still due to take place


65 00:19:28 Hayley you know we always said uhm (cries) not another boy I would be harmed on our watch. In 2020 we took our eye off the ball and got word during the course of that week that Enock was missing and then later on that he had died of drowned.
